en: Well, back to business for me.  But it sure was nice taking that short break, and it's always nice drinking Thunder Ale!
Open it and be careful this time!
May your soul burn in anguish, Isillien! Light give me strength to battle this fiend.
Make the journey to Orgrimmar and seek him out in the Valley of Honor. He works in a shop called the Arms of Legend.

Lady Sylvanas has ordered the investigation of some of the natural phenomena of Azeroth. She feels there is something great to be learned from its secretive past.$B$BI know not how she learned such things, but I trust her completely, so I will do my best.$B$BI am currently investigating slimes, oozes and such. The creatures all seem to be similar in make up, but greatly affected by their environment.$B$BI could use your help in gathering samples of the creatures..
What?  How dare you say that to me?!?
What what?!?  We all have profit to make... and we won't do it by standing idle.

A closer inspection of the pylon leads you to find a small table containing red, blue, and green crystals arranged in what seems like a specific formation.$B$BA large red circle of crystals is flanked on either side by a smaller circle of blue crystals and another of green crystals.$B$BYou carefully take note of the colors of the crystals, knowing that J.D. would be very interested in hearing about what you have found.
Alarm-a-bomb unit 2600 has failed. Self-destruct override [ACTIVE]. Cooldown [ACTIVE].
Morning, my friends.
I require training, Arnok.
Tell me of Captain Balinda Stonehearth.

Take pride, $c, in the fact that the Alliance has completed all of the gathering tasks set before it. The finished products are stored and preserved, and our tradeskill professionals are hard at work molding those raw materials into war materiel that will be shipped to Silithus as soon as the Horde finishes their collections.
Your talents excel! You are truly inspired. To continue your pursuit of knowledge, speak with Georgio Bolero in Stormwind. He is held in high regard, and will be able to further your instruction.
Elder Graveborn spends time near Brill in Tirisfal Glades.
Godan's Runeworks is where you'll go.  Look for it on the west end of The Drag, right next to the Valley of Wisdom.

Restraints? There are things in this world far more restraining than bars and shackles, young $g master:mistress;. The undead surrounded us, constantly tormenting us with horrifying acts of depravity.$B$BFinally, he came. He introduced himself as Doctor Theolen Krastinov. We came to know him as 'The Butcher.'

Ever vigilant in their protection of the natural world, the druids are guided by Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm who resides in the Cenarion Enclave.  You will find him and the other Druid trainers in the northern section of Darnassus.

The dragon hides behind a royal facade. The tablets will reveal her for what she is... If what I have seen holds true, I will not survive this battle, friend. It is you that must finish what I have started. Are your forces ready? Are you ready? We will begin on your command.
Perhaps you will tell me of your deeds, $n.  I would be honored to know them.
I hope to one day forge weapons and armor from the bones of my enemies.
You no take candle!
The Scarlet Crusade of Tyr's Hand in the Eastern Plaguelands have many lockboxes that will challenge your skill.
The only weapon I know of that has no use other than killing someone. Not something, but someone. These blades were invented to end the lives of men. Beautiful aren't they?
What function do you serve?
Our fate is the doom of all who face the Great Fire.
I'm going to kick yer ugly head in!
I quietly ignore the insult.  I will not tell my liege, as I am to secure peace at all costs.  It's only an insult - not a declaration of war.

I know who you are, $n.  Fate and forces beyond that have brought you to me for a reason, and it is one I take no pleasure in being a part of.  There are many decisions you will make in the coming times, and I hope you are wise enough to make the correct ones.$B$BBelieve me, $r, when I tell you this - there are correct choices.
Vek'lor, I feel your pain!
You are forgiven...
Show me the drinks!
What... happen to-
Enemy ho! Fire!
Tauren.
%s seems much calmer now that it has eaten the remains of $n.
Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?
You can find Vance Undergloom upstairs in a room at the Gallows' End Tavern on the southeast side of Brill.
You're pushing it, $n.
